nodes.title: director14: script walk v6.5 on int/r6 c98ee3617 (integration 17), run by main, 16 lessons, 1,428 calls ~$0.980 in one run; reply-ready per-lesson p50 median 3091→2640 ms, read p50 1215→1070 ms; counted by hand by 4 Claude judges (0-based rows, by mechanism): beats 254/256 (99%), verdicts 247/248, misgrades 0/0, false keys 1 (first in nine runs: c4 steady 20, a model-written verdict sentence '…milkar 1/3 hota hai' over the 1/2 roti); contradictions 22 (paging 17, second view 4, model words 1) vs director13 13; per topic c4 2, c5-t01 10, c5-t02 5, c6 5 (from 0). 16 of the 17 paging are one new mechanism: a graded close opened with a v6.5 verdict variant said over the next card's board (23/104 verdict-then-next turns unpaged vs 6/92). Register 3 in all four topics; listening 3–3.5; promises 2.5–3.5. Brain's v6.5 proxies: frameRepeat 49→0, taste claims 9→0, remediations re-said 7→0, canned facts 5→0, 'Pichhle sawaal' on the live card 11→0, droppedPages 3→0. The gate's automatic counter read 9 contradictions against the hand count of 22.

Script walk v6.6: pages by construction; no model words on a graded turn. Brain: P4 say.js returns her line as an ordered list of parts (close, closed, bridge, simpler, alt, aside, body, card), each with its board; every later pass edits within a part; the line is their join and the page plan is the list (spanOf/closureEnd text search deleted from planning); predicates throw in tests: a graded close plus a next card is ≥2 pages with the first on the answered card's board, a picture turn is the alt part then the card part on the card's board, every part in order in the final line; V1 (reversal clause 2 taken) the verdict is a code frame plus the authored why (never the model's own affirmation), scripted turns are the authored line plus one code frame, the model writes only the aside reply (≤20 words, ≤1 question, about the aside); B1′ Hindi/clarify re-says the LIVE beat's own simpler (the worked step during a worked example), code drops any '?' sentence outside the card or aside; A2 a pending-aside queue no later request clears, returned by the next boundary or at break/stop, one park promise, the honest-AI line on the turn asked, once, never presuming the child's taste, ending on one question to them, returns never echoes; F1′ every code frame family (incl. '<answer> sahi nahi hai', give-up, re-pose, check-ins, 'Sahi, Riya—') has 3–5 forms with no repeat within 4 turns anywhere in her line, try-first gets an invitation, no code-speak; K3 the last card of a skill gives key+why before the bridge, the parent card re-posed after its then-card even past a probe, a second miss never a bare re-pose, 'aage chalo' during a K1 re-pose gives the key and moves on; H3 the contradiction counter reads the pages actually drawn and must flag ≥20/22 of director14's hand rows with ≤2 false flags before the next paid run. Studio: S9 a picture turn's card page draws the card's own board (c5-t01 4/4 drew the alt on both pages); S9b second views on remediation boards. Learning: D9 no bare symbols in spoken fields ('question mark wala nishaan'), a remediation never states a later card's key, c5-t02 s1 then-card on its unmarked board, c4 yourStep board draws the eaten pieces, worked-example givens folded into one spoken sentence. Why: director14 contradictions rose 13→22 and false keys 0→1; 16 of 17 paging trace to v6.5's F1 swap editing her line after the page plan's part texts were taken; the false key and the invented reads trace to the model's own verdict words; register has sat at 2.5–3 for five runs through two remedies. Clause 1 (21 > 5) not taken as written: a held board per card does not remove a close said over the next card at a card seam, and would make every picture request 'nothing new'; its intent, removing the part that keeps breaking, is taken as P4. Reverse: director15 has more than 5 paging + second-view contradictions by hand → one code-drawn board per card, held, unconditionally (third run in which clause 1's count was exceeded); register still below 3.5 with V1 and F1′ in place → Learning rewrites the four pilot scripts' spoken fields for register before any batch; H3's counter misses more than 2 of the hand count → README proxy trend lines are not used as evidence until fixed.

Finding a turn's page boundaries by searching the finished line for each part's text (propose.js segmentsAt: spanOf on guard.parts, closureEnd fallback). It breaks whenever any pass edits the line after the part texts are taken: v6.3's sentence dedupe cut remediation fragments; refused pages left lines spoken over the wrong board; v6.5's F1 opener swap ('Haan, sahi hai' → 'Bilkul sahi') after guard.parts made the close part come out empty, putting 16 graded closes over the next card's board in director14. Replaced by pages by construction (v6.6 P4).

Reading the gate's automatic contradiction counter (gate.v6 / proxies-v64) as a trend: on director14 it read 17→9, an improvement, while the hand count went 13→22. It checks closeBeat.board rather than the page drawn, so it cannot see a close spoken on the next card's page or a picture turn's card page drawn as the alt view (c5-t01 0/10 seen, c5-t02 0/5 with 5 false flags, c6 1/5, c4 0/2). Hand counts remain the gate; the counter must pass a director14 fixture (v6.6 H3) before its numbers are read as evidence.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-script-walk-v6-6` (2026-11-09)

Pages by construction, and no model words on a graded turn.

**Brain:**
- **P4:** her line is an ordered list of parts, each with its board. Later passes edit within a part. The page plan is that list, and no text search is used.
- **V1** (reversal clause 2 taken): the verdict is a code frame plus the authored why. The model writes only the aside reply.
- **B1′:** Hindi and clarify requests re-say the live beat's own simpler.
- **A2:** a pending-aside queue no later request can clear, plus the honest-AI line on the turn the child asks.
- **F1′:** every code frame family is varied.
- **K3:** the give-up comes before the bridge, the parent card is re-posed, and "aage chalo" moves on.
- **H3:** the counter reads the pages actually drawn, and must flag director14's hand rows.

**Studio:**
- **S9:** a picture turn's card page draws the card's own board.
- **S9b:** second views on remediation boards too.

**Learning:**
- **D9:** no bare symbols in spoken text; a remediation never states a later card's key; three board fixes; worked-example givens folded into one sentence.

**Why:** director14's contradictions rose from 13 to 22, and false keys from 0 to 1. Both trace to `say.js` editing her line after the page plan took its part texts, and to keeping the model's own verdict words. Register has sat at 2.5–3 for five runs.

**Clause 1** (21 > 5) is not taken as written: a held board per card keeps the card-seam failure and breaks picture requests. Its intent is taken as P4.

**Reverse if:**
- director15 has more than 5 paging plus second-view contradictions by hand: one code-drawn board per card, held, unconditionally.
- register is still below 3.5 with V1 and F1′ in place: Learning rewrites the pilot scripts' spoken fields for register.
- the counter misses more than 2 of the hand count: README proxy trends stop counting as evidence.
md.rejected:
## `rj-r7-pages-found-by-text-search` (2026-11-09)

The tried approach: find a turn's page boundaries by searching the finished line for each part's text (`segmentsAt`: `spanOf` on `guard.parts`, with a `closureEnd` fallback).

**What broke:** it fails whenever a pass edits the line after the part texts are taken. It has now broken three times:
- v6.3's dedupe cut remediation fragments;
- refused pages left their lines spoken over the wrong board;
- v6.5's F1 opener swap emptied the close part. That put 16 graded closes over the next card's board in director14.

Replaced by pages by construction (v6.6 P4).

## `rj-r7-proxy-contradiction-trend` (2026-11-09)

The tried approach: read the gate's automatic contradiction counter as a trend line.

**What broke:** on director14 it read 17 → 9 while the hand count went 13 → 22. It checks `closeBeat.board`, not the page actually drawn, so it is blind to both of the run's main mechanisms.

Hand counts stay the gate. The counter must pass a director14 fixture before its numbers count as evidence.
